notes: Seat-to-text mapping (01/08 Plato, 04/01 Aristotle, 09/01 Theophrastus, 12/01 DL, 06/01 Xenophon, 06/02 Aristophanes, 31/01 Athenaeus, 13/01–02 Plutarch/Arrian) follows lines 10 and 246–253; line 10 also names EA-CORPORA-38/04 for Theophrastus without saying which text. GA, PA, IA left as the text abbreviates them. Not entered, as they reach the text only through quotation in Athenaeus or DL: Aristophanes' Daedalus, Theopompus, Epicharmus (line 119), Favorinus (line 174). The Theophrastus titles Peri kōmōidias, Peri geloiou, Peri basileias, Peri paideias basileōs (lines 133, 193) are named from the DL catalogue only, not as sources, and not entered. Diogenes of Apollonia's words are entered under Simplicius. #1506, #1559, #1579, #1581, #1592, #1792, #1793 are records, excluded.
